name: daniels-cloud-portfolio
description: Daniel Ajayi Lotsu — backend & cloud engineer portfolio, with a content API backed by Vercel Blob
comment: No 'build' script on purpose: Vercel would treat this as a framework build and look for an output directory. index.html and cms.html are generated by 'npm run generate' and committed, so the deploy is static files plus the api/ functions.
comment2: No "dev" script either: vercel dev runs a project's dev command, so a dev script that calls vercel dev makes it recurse and refuse to start. Run npx vercel dev directly.
